records.mechanism_match: partial: recovery of existing lifecycle vs multi-feature roadmap construction
records.different_task: different repository, functions and requirements; no original task code used in sample
records.training_value_hypothesis: API framework navigation, state-machine repair, dependency and resource lifecycle reasoning; weaker evidence for roadmap design and broad integration

Nine functions are not equivalent to eight independent roadmap features.
Only three editable files constrain cross-module engineering.
Behavior check roster is not an implemented verifier.
required_changes: Keep RESTler as a source but create a coherent new feature roadmap spanning parsing/configuration, asynchronous execution, dependency lifecycle and diagnostics.

Use independently achievable feature groups plus cross-feature integration checks; permit necessary module edits.
proposed_progression: Implement new lifecycle and dependency behavior
Handle cross-feature error recovery, compatibility and coverage
novelty_unresolved: Full source/test overlap against original hidden assets

records.six_hour_design_verdict: not aligned yet; reconstruct the scientific work
critical_gaps: Exact forward model supplied to agent, turning model construction into parameter fitting.
Infinite-domain constant-coefficient scene omits original grid/bottom context and censored observations.
More fitted parameters do not establish greater difficulty; source shape/dispersion can be weakly identifiable.
Single fixed truth does not by itself establish a reusable training task family.
required_changes: Keep private generating code; publish sufficient equations, geometry, physical inputs and measurement protocol so model construction is well specified.
Supply an independently sourced scene and realistic censoring/noise with explicit metadata; do not add unexplained hidden physics.
Reward withheld spatial/future prediction with meaningful physical subchecks; audit trivial low-concentration fits.
Require reproducible inference source and answer snapshot; count different work packages rather than only changed random seeds.
proposed_progression: Implement and check physical forward approximation
Fit release geometry and time jointly
Improve model fidelity, identifiability and held-out prediction

records.mechanism_match: strong: improve a real irregular packing solver under fixed compute and independent geometry checks
records.different_task: different C++ repository and selected OpenCutList designs; original Rust code not used
records.training_value_hypothesis: strongest direct candidate for optimizer engineering, profiling, geometric reasoning and iterative algorithm improvement
critical_gaps: Absolute utilization can reward an untouched strong solver; original explicitly measures improvement over frozen reference.
Three feedback/final cases offer weak coverage of algorithmic tradeoffs.
Longer per-case compute does not make agent work deeper.
Original hidden polygon datasets have not been extracted, so shape-lineage disjointness is not established.
required_changes: Preserve pinned baseline and use a metadata-defined reference-relative improvement score or equivalent verified improvement gate.
Expand independent design families and stratify by concavity, holes, rotations, repeated pieces and scale while preserving strip-packing semantics.
Use the same per-case compute for reference and candidate; protect independent geometry verifier.
First inspect original task document/scorer to confirm geometry constraints and normalization before exact matching.
proposed_progression: Improve placement/ordering neighborhoods and geometry speed
Tune search/restarts across held-out shape families

records.mechanism_match: weak as a whole-task match; current task covers only risk forecasting
records.different_task: different real industry-return panel, mandates and periods, but also changes asset universe and objective
records.training_value_hypothesis: risk estimation subskill only; not a substitute for dynamic portfolio system training
records.six_hour_design_verdict: not aligned; replace or substantially rebuild task/data package
critical_gaps: 49 equity industries do not recreate 10 cross-asset ETF risk structure.
Fixed weights remove constrained optimization and dynamic allocation.
QLIKE/pinball scoring is a different objective from system-level risk-adjusted performance and accounting consistency.
More historical rows do not compensate for missing decision modules.
required_changes: Acquire an independently licensed cross-asset price/volume panel and state indicators with a new asset universe and period.
Construct a new but comparable mandate with covariance/tail calibration, constrained dynamic allocation, execution costs and event-driven rebalancing.
Define trusted accounting and all constraints numerically; remove ambiguities instead of copying inconsistent source wording.
Keep the present forecast task only as an explicitly labeled curriculum subtask.
proposed_progression: Correct causal accounting and feasible allocations
Cost-aware timing, regime adaptation and robustness
novelty_unresolved: No empirical transfer from risk forecasts to original full system

Select several independent proof branches from the same new mathematical development, each with intermediate and synthesis goals.
Audit alternate theorem routes, remaining sorries and transitive dependencies; keep exact signatures frozen.

Simple rush opponents and shared map topology may be exploitable.

96*6000*0.1s = 16h candidate-action upper-bound work if every cycle uses full allowance; actual runtime unmeasured.

If retaining microRTS, diversify terrain topology, resource access and opponent strategies, not only numeric settings.
Restore a score-sensitive late improvement dimension with no reward for harmful actions.
Use a bounded fast feedback suite plus separate broad evaluation; publish whole-evaluation budget and permit a source directory.
proposed_progression: Legal basic bot and resource economy
Generalize across map topologies and opponent tactics
novelty_unresolved: Diversity and determinism of authored maps
